answer: The pewterer's moulds hang on the wall in pairs, and the metal is poured only when the mould is hot enough to take it. Proof of baker loaf via oven bake record is the casting: a loaf the baker pulls only after 5 ovens run hot, each oven stoked by the baker himself. The karst is the first pour, made when the mould was warmed; the mesa is the eighth, made when the plate was trimmed. A cheat must pour 25 false plates and warm 25 false moulds, and the summit still serves no supper.
